title: Rep Papers
description: A lightweight reputation plugin that gives players collectible Reputation Papers when repped so players know who is trusted.
body:
# 📜 ReputationPapers

ReputationPapers is a lightweight and unique reputation plugin that turns player reputation into physical, collectible items.
Instead of reputation being just a number, players receive glowing Reputation Papers that act as proof of being repped complete with player names, dates, and serial numbers.

Perfect for SMPs, survival servers, and social communities.

![Reputation Paper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/927b700ac46a78566a65868697bda51c1b4bbe65.jpeg)

## ✨ Features

• Give reputation with simple commands
• Players receive collectible glowing Reputation Papers
• Each paper includes:

Player who gave rep
Player who received rep
Date issued
Unique serial number

• Anti-spam cooldown system
• Persistent reputation saving
• Lightweight and lag-free
• No dependencies required

## 📜 Commands

/rep <player> – Give reputation
/reputation <player> – Alias for /rep
/repcheck <player> – View a player’s reputation

## ⏱ Cooldown System

To prevent abuse, players can only give reputation once every 5 minutes by default.

## 🎁 Why ReputationPapers?

✔ Turns rep into physical collectibles
✔ Encourages positive player interaction
✔ Creates trading & collecting potential
✔ More engaging than simple rep numbers
✔ Works out of the box

## ⚙ Compatibility

Platforms: Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Purpur
Minecraft Versions: 1.20+

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the plugin

2. Place the .jar into your /plugins folder

3. Restart the server

Start giving reputation!

## 📝 Example Use Case

Players can:
• Collect rare old rep papers
• Trade them
• Flex famous players who repped them
• Build rep museums

ReputationPapers turns reputation into something meaningful, collectible, and fun.
